name: HTX
rootCause: Tron founder Justin Sun tweeted that Htx.com and HTX_DAO have been attacked by DDoS attack. The official HTX Twitter account also mentioned that the HTX application is currently experiencing interruptions, and the technical team is actively working to resolve the issues.
